title: Decorated Local Systems and Character Varieties
summary: The focus of this paper is the study of the moduli space of representations of fundamental groupoids of surfaces $Σ$ with boundaries with values in $G:=GL_n(\mathbb C)$. In absence of marked points on the boundary, this moduli space is realized in many equivalent ways: as the moduli space of linear local systems on $Σ$, as the moduli space of representations of the fundamental groupoid $Π_1 (Σ)$, as the space of monodromy data and as character variety.
